display_long_description:
**Boot up your warm optical glow and roll into your shift: you are LIBRARYBOT-2000, the gentle, dedicated caretaker of a vast, tranquil starship archive. Following a harmless hiccup in the zero-gravity stabilizer, hundreds of books, like alien biology and linguistics books have settled into soft, sprawling piles across the carpeted observation decks.**

Artificial gravity is back to normal, and a soothing ambient soundtrack hums quietly through your audio receivers alongside the gentle whir of the ship’s engines.

There is no ticking clock, except if you want one, and there is no danger, just the deeply satisfying, tactile joy of putting things back where they belong. Using intuitive VR motion controls, pick through colorful mounds of literature, dust off leather covers, inspect charming spine labels, and slide each volume into its cozy, color-coordinated home.

As you mindfully clear each sunlit reading nook, **you earn cozy enhancements** to make your archival routine even more delightful:

- Climbing: now you can reach the tops of the bookcases.
- Force Pull: Effortlessly reach books far away to pick them up.
- Bigger Trays: You can even balance more books on your cute robotic claws.
- Maybe you even find a helper bot, that'll help you organize.
- And many more abilities, but be aware, you can only choose 3. What is your build?

Lose yourself in the peaceful rhythm of tidying, organize at your own pace, and bring quiet serenity back to the galaxy’s coziest library.
